# Tamil Nadu — GP-president reservation sources

*Generated by `make state-readmes`. Edit the generator or source-specific guides; this overview is overwritten.*

These nested exports retain their source units and are separate from the pooled seat-event schema. They record office reservations and amendment instructions, not observed presidents or their sex.

| Source | Row unit | Rows | Guide |
|---|---|---:|---|
| [2011 CSV](derived/heads_2011/gp_president_reservations.csv) | Named GP-president roster entry | 12,524 | [2011 source guide](derived/heads_2011/README.md) |
| [2001 CSV](derived/amendments_2001/gp_president_amendment_operations.csv) | Amendment operation | 456 | [2001 source guide](derived/amendments_2001/README.md) |

The 2011 roster covers 31 printed districts and 385 district/union identities. 1 reservation cell(s) are blank and remain unknown. Explicit General categories are retained; no category is inferred from nonlisting.

The 2001 operations comprise 17 `insert`, 5 `replace_category`, 434 `replace_section`. Operations are not a complete GP roster or a count of unique GPs. They must not be appended to the 2011 roster as additional offices.

Both guides describe identifiers, source pages, raw readings, typed exports, verification and remaining uncertainty. Counts here are read from the two CSV exports each time the overview is generated.

Original rural gazettes and the historical search are recorded in the [early-source ledger](../source_search/early_heads/README.md). [Scan review](derived/scans/review.md) preserves OCR limitations. Earlier scans and later amendments do not automatically establish reservation histories or election outcomes.

[Urban Tamil Nadu holdings](../tamil_nadu/readme.md) are maintained in their existing directory.
